briefdescription.para: Takes and locks a mutex indefinetly.
Takes and locks a mutex, waiting for up to a certain number of milliseconds before timing out.
Takes and locks a mutex, waiting for up to TIMEOUT_MAX milliseconds.

detaileddescription.para: Effectively equivalent to calling pros::RecursiveMutex::take with TIMEOUT_MAX as the parameter.

Conforms to named requirement Lockable 
https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/named_req/Lockable


True when lock was acquired succesfully, or false otherwise.

pros::RecursiveMutex mutex;

void my_task_fn(void* param) { while (true) { if(mutex.try_lock()) { printf("Mutex aquired successfully!\n"); // Do stuff that requires the protected resource here } else { printf("Mutex not aquired!\n"); } } }

briefdescription.para: Takes and locks a mutex, waiting for a specified duration.

detaileddescription.para: Equivalent to calling pros::RecursiveMutex::take with a duration specified in milliseconds.

briefdescription.para: Takes and locks a mutex, waiting until a specified time.
